title: 4 Secrets Players Just Found in GTA 6
short_title: GTA 6: 4 secrets and exactly where they are #GTA6 #Shorts
short_title_options: GTA 6 has a Paul Walker tribute (+3 secrets) #GTA6 #Shorts
GTA 6 secrets: Bigfoot, Paul Walker, an egg #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
Four things players found in GTA 6's first days (no story spoilers): 1) a tribute to Paul Walker's car from the first Fast & Furious (Jalopnik, BGR, Gfinity, Insider Gaming); 2) a Bigfoot-like creature the locals call the Skunk Ape, in Leonida's swamps (VGC, Dread Central, Dexerto); 3) an NPC in Belville who believes the world is a simulation, with a conspiracy board about Jason and Lucia (Unilad, Yahoo); 4) a literal Easter egg: climb a communications tower for over six minutes, find a nest, throw an egg (IBTimes, games.gg). Which one are you looking for first?

Where: Paul Walker's car is in a villa garage on Vespucci Island (Rialto Islands); the Skunk Ape shows up around Cottonmouth Lake in Grassrivers at night; the self-aware NPC's notes are in a garage in Belville; the egg tower is a radio mast in Bluegrass, north of Hamlet (some guides say South Vice-Dale). Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Every spot pinned on our interactive map: vicereplay.com/guides/gta-6-map-leonida-places/
